name: ViewSet for organization-level integrations
description: ViewSet for organization-level integrations ViewSet for organization-level integrations. PATCH /api/organizations/{organization_id}/integrations/{id}/environment-mapping/
context:
PATCH /api/organizations/{organization_id}/integrations/{id}/environment-mapping/
ViewSet for organization-level integrations. Provides access to integrations that are scoped to the entire organization (vs. project-level integrations). Examples include Vercel, AWS Marketplace, etc. Creation is handled by the integration installation flows (e.g., Vercel marketplace installation). Users can disconnect integrations via the DELETE endpoint.
Required: id (path) — A UUID string identifying this organization integration.; organization_id (path) — ID of the organization you're trying to access. To find the ID of the organization, make a call to /api/organizations/.
Optional: body (body)
